note: Read-only probes proving the effects of every grandfathered duplicate-version migration file are present on persistent staging. A recorded version row does NOT prove every file sharing that version ran (supabase_migrations.schema_migrations holds one row per version). Staging was built by scripts/remote-migration-apply.mjs, which executed every file; these probes verify it. Fails closed when a duplicate file has no entry, its SHA-256 changed, or a probe is not true.

files.description: The on_room_status_change trigger on room_status is gone
files.probe: select not exists(select 1 from pg_trigger t join pg_class c on c.oid=t.tgrelid where t.tgname='on_room_status_change' and c.relname='room_status' and not t.tgisinternal)

files.description: The ten indexes this file drops are absent (a later migration that recreates one must update this probe)
files.probe: select not exists(select 1 from pg_indexes where schemaname='public' and indexname in ('idx_work_orders_asset_id','idx_work_orders_assigned_to','idx_work_orders_tenant_created','idx_work_orders_tenant_unclaimed','sop_chunks_embedding_idx','idx_opera_oauth_states_nonce','idx_opera_oauth_states_expiry','idx_room_assignments_tenant_date_assignee','idx_guest_requests_tenant_created','idx_guest_requests_tenant_status'))
select exists(select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name='guest_requests' and column_name='priority')

files.description: lost-found-photos bucket and both storage.objects policies exist
files.probe: select exists(select 1 from storage.buckets where id='lost-found-photos') and (select count(*) from pg_policies where schemaname='storage' and tablename='objects' and policyname in ('Authenticated staff can upload lost-found photos','Public can view lost-found photos'))=2
select exists(select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name='room_assignments' and column_name='clean_type')
select exists(select 1 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname='create_room_unavailability' and p.pronargs=11)

files.description: assets.zone, work_orders.snoozed_until and the three checklist tables exist
files.probe: select (select exists(select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name='assets' and column_name='zone')) and (select exists(select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name='work_orders' and column_name='snoozed_until')) and to_regclass('public.work_order_checklist_templates') is not null and to_regclass('public.work_order_checklist_template_items') is not null and to_regclass('public.work_order_checklist_items') is not null
